_about: The icon files made from the theme's icon (size in px and what each is for), and the icon settings' labels and help.

favicon.ico.label: Browser tab icon (16, 32 and 48 px in one file)

favicon.svg.label: Browser tab icon that follows light and dark mode

icon-192.png.label: Android home screen and app icon

icon-maskable-512.png.label: Android adaptive icon (cropped to a circle or squircle)

background.label: Icon background
background.help: A hex color behind it, e.g. #ffffff. Blank: transparent.

padding.label: Icon padding (%)
padding.help: Space around the icon on each side, 0–25% of its size.
